youtube_description:
From precision in automotive to efficiency in pharmaceuticals, learn how businesses are harnessing AI in manufacturing for cost savings and quality enhancements.

𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞: BMW saved $1 million annually through AI-powered robots in manufacturing.
𝐄𝐥𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐬: NVIDIA optimized a design featuring 2.7 million cells and 320 macros through AI in just three hours.
𝐀𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐞: Airbus reduced aircraft aerodynamics prediction time from an hour to just 30 milliseconds.

The global AI in #manufacturing market is expected to hit around USD 68.36 billion by 2032.

Read my newsletter on LinkedIn to learn how various industries are leveraging #AI to streamline their manufacturing processes and how you can get started with your AI pilot.
